content.hook_text: A prayer for when you feel overwhelmed
content.subtext: You don't have to carry it all alone
content.prayer: Lord, I come to You feeling overwhelmed and heavy-hearted. The weight of today feels like more than I can bear. But Your Word reminds me that You are my refuge and strength — a very present help in trouble. I release my anxieties into Your hands. Give me Your peace that surpasses understanding. Help me to take one step at a time, trusting that You walk beside me. Renew my strength. Quiet my racing thoughts. Remind me that I am never alone. In Jesus' name, Amen.
content.cta: Write your own prayers in SOAPaDay
content.caption:
Some days the weight feels heavier than others. 🙏

If that's you today, here's a prayer to carry with you. You don't have to have it all figured out — you just have to bring it to Him.

What's weighing on your heart today? Drop a 🙏 if you need this prayer.
